visual_description: A large metal box with a slanted glass viewing window. Two heavy black rubber gloves are built into the front, sticking inward. Inside, the TRX-07 bone is illuminated by bright internal LED strips. The interior glass is slightly frosted from abrasive over-spray.

constraints.material: Powder-coated steel; tempered glass; heavy industrial rubber.
constraints.logic: Provides 100% dust containment for the micro-blasting process.
